idea-plugin.name: i18n-doctor
idea-plugin.description:
Live i18n diagnostics for JavaScript & TypeScript

Underlines missing, unused, and duplicate translation keys as you type. Also provides Go to Translation, Hover, and Completion via the bundled i18n-doctor language server over LSP — this plugin does not re-implement analysis.

  • t("auth.nonexistent") — underlines exactly "auth.nonexistent"
  • Cmd/Ctrl+Click a key — jump to its catalog entry
  • Hover a key — see locale values, namespace, and source
  • Type inside t("…") — complete translation keys
  • Unused catalog keys — highlighted on the property name in every locale file
  • Live updates for unsaved buffers — no IDE restart
  • No project dependency — the language server is shipped inside the plugin

Requires Node.js ≥ 18. Configure it under Settings → Languages & Frameworks → JavaScript Runtime (or set an explicit Node path under i18n-doctor settings).

Compatible with WebStorm / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate / PhpStorm and other IDEs that include the platform LSP API (2024.3+).

Docs: packages/jetbrains
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.11.9

Props-t / path-alias / multi-namespace usage fixes for fewer false unused and missing keys.

  • Path-alias imports (app/*, @core/*) for translator factories
  • Store/object methods with t; renamed Zustand selectors
  • Multi-namespace addResourceBundle on one shared module
  • String-literal array maps, enum-typed t(type as string), labelKey lookups
  • npm / ESLint / language-server / JetBrains / VS Code all at 0.11.9
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.9

0.11.8

Broader static key resolution: helpers, string maps, chart/route configs, enum Object.keys, and useTranslation fallbacks.

  • t(getTitleByStatusType(…)), t(descriptions[item]), t(config.title)
  • Route titles via getRouteParam(..., "title")
  • Object.keys(Enum).map((key) => t(key)) and useTranslation(ref || "ns")
  • npm / ESLint / language-server / JetBrains / VS Code all at 0.11.8
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.8

0.11.7

Navigation config keys via t(item.translation) on props count as used. Unified release with npm packages.

  • Prop-passed config objects (e.g. NavItem + navigationConfig) resolve keys
  • Nested children arrays in nav/menu configs are included
  • npm / ESLint / language-server / JetBrains / VS Code all at 0.11.7
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.7

0.11.6

String enums used via t(item.name) / t(Enum.Member) count as used.

  • useState arrays updated with WpNavbar.SENSITIVE_TERMS resolve through .map
  • Imported string enums resolve even through path aliases
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.5

0.11.5

Column/factory helpers that take t inherit the caller namespace.

  • usersColumns(t) with useTranslation("usersManagement") — keys like USER_NAME resolve in that namespace
  • Fixes false missing-key on t("…") inside (t: TFunction) => … factories
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.4

0.11.4

Form-field config labels via t(field.label) count as used.

  • Static object-array maps (e.g. userFormFields().map(f => t(f.label))) resolve keys
  • Cross-file factories that return field configs are supported
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.3

0.11.3

Static ternary keys count as used (no false unused warnings).

  • t(cond ? "A" : "B") — both branches are usages
  • const k = cond ? "A" : "B"; t(k) — same-file const ternaries resolve
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.2

0.11.2

Faster locale coverage warnings + ignoreKeys / coverage hardener.

  • Locale file edits update missing-translation without waiting the full debounce window
  • App/source edits no longer force catalog rediscovery (keeps coverage warm)
  • ignoreKeys still suppresses only unused-key — locale gaps stay reported
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.11.1

0.11.1

Fix: ignoreKeys must not suppress locale coverage warnings.

  • ignoreKeys still suppresses only unused-key
  • Keys missing in another locale (e.g. SERVER_X in en but not fr) still report missing-translation
  • Rebundled language server with the coverage hardener

0.11.0

Phase 20 — Translation Intelligence (Go to Translation, Hover, Completion).

  • Go to Translation — navigate from t("key") to the catalog entry
  • Hover — show locale values, namespace, and source location
  • Completion — suggest translation keys inside supported calls
  • Shared translation index with ESLint / analyzer (no second parser)

0.10.3

Marketplace integrity fix: do not disturb the IDE Trial widget.

  • Start the language server only in i18n-relevant projects (config, i18n deps, or locales)
  • Skip automatic start when Node.js / server binary is unavailable — log instead of throwing

0.10.2

Monorepo release with settings, ignoreKeys, and ESLint cache fixes.

  • Log level / debounce apply immediately — saving Settings → i18n-doctor restarts the language server
  • ignoreKeys matching — SERVER_* also matches namespaced / nested keys
  • Config without i18n-doctor package — plain JSON / object configs work for IDE-only users
  • Rebundled language server @ 0.10.2

0.10.1

Bug fixes for settings, ignoreKeys, and config without a CLI install.

  • Log level / debounce apply immediately — saving Settings → i18n-doctor now restarts the language server so overrides take effect (previously only applied on cold start)
  • ignoreKeys matching — patterns like SERVER_* also match namespaced / nested keys (common:SERVER_USER, errors.SERVER_TIMEOUT)
  • Config without i18n-doctor package — use plain i18n-doctor.config.json or export default { ignoreKeys: […] }; no import required for IDE-only users
  • Rebundled language server with the above fixes

0.10.0

Unified configuration — one i18n-doctor.config.ts for CLI, ESLint, and IDE.

  • The language server now loads the same i18n-doctor.config.ts from the workspace root
  • New ignoreKeys option (glob patterns) to suppress unused findings for backend-provided or dynamically referenced keys
  • ignoreKeys affects only unused — missing-key, duplicate-key, locale-consistency, and hardcoded-text detection stay active
  • TypeScript configs are parsed statically and never executed — no build step needed
  • Clear errors naming the file for invalid configs
  • Rebundled language server with the above

0.9.5

Detect hardcoded UI text that is not passed through translation helpers.

  • New untranslated-text findings for JSX text and common UI attributes
  • Default severity: info (raise via config rules["untranslated-text"])

0.9.4

Analyzer improvements in the bundled language server.

  • Detect keys used via prop-passed t (e.g. { t } / props.t)
  • Resolve statically concatenated keys (e.g. t("HELLO_" + "AGAIN"))
  • Soften unused-key findings when a dynamic usage may cover the key (e.g. t("HELLO_" + suffix))

0.9.3

Fix Marketplace Plugin Verifier rejection: stop using internal Platform APIs.

  • Resolve plugin path via public PluginPathManager (no PluginManagerCore.getPlugin)
  • Extract bundled server under PathManager.getTempPath() instead of scheduled-for-removal getPluginTempPath

0.9.2

JetBrains Marketplace release.

  • LSP client for the bundled i18n-doctor language server
  • Live diagnostics for missing / unused / duplicate / coverage keys
  • Self-contained server bundle (no project dependency required)
  • Uses WebStorm JavaScript Runtime for Node.js when available
  • Plugin icons for light and dark themes
